implementation.artwork: Original generated photograph of a fictional adult, served locally as a 302 KB JPEG. Exact prompt and provenance are in editorial-artwork.json. No external image requests.
implementation.interaction: Three opening topics explain the available help. Starting from a topic preselects that concern and retains existing plan concerns and services. No account is connected or changed.
implementation.motion: Slow CSS camera drift, with an explicit pause/play control. Pauses outside the viewport and in a hidden tab. Reduced-motion preference defaults to a static image with explicit opt-in playback. This is not a video of a person.
implementation.workspace: Dark olive header, pale chartreuse controls, locally hosted Archivo display type, clear light working surfaces and flatter navigation. The previous Three.js renderer and dependency were removed.
implementation.disclosure: The introduction states that Try Me is a scripted example and that the companion cannot change accounts. The functional interface works even if the photograph cannot load.

validation.localBrowserRun: 70 passed in the full run; one WebKit save/restore failure did not reproduce in the targeted three-engine run or three additional WebKit repetitions. The final topic-selection change, including retention of existing concerns, passed in all three engines. Source edits occurred during the first full run; the failed check was not weakened.
